text:
alice: kicking off ff rollout for experiments/service-slimline v2 in eu-west during the midnight change window. Plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m with health gates. rolling deploy ID: r-20260320-ff1. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20/ff-deploy

deploy-bot: start rollout r-20260320-ff1: cohort=eu-west, initial_pct=0.5, schedule=[5m,10m,15m,none], canary=true

ben: ack. will watch canary telemetry. can we pin model-version=stable-20260315 for this cohort? avoids variant drift.

carla: +1 on pin. also set cache warmup on the canary nodes (kv cache prefetch). otherwise we'll see cold latency spikes.

alice: pinned model-version=stable-20260315 for eu-west slice. cache prewarm script: `./scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --cohort eu-west --keys 100k` 

dinesh: ops note: set region routing to prefer eu-west-1a to reduce cross-az egress. also add holdpoint between 5% -> 25% for manual approval if error_rate > 0.8% or p95 latency delta > 200ms.

ops-oncall: copying thresholds to alerting channel. alert rules: `error_rate > 0.8% for 2m` OR `p95_delta > 200ms for 1m` triggers urgent. I have pager on.

deploy-bot: r-20260320-ff1 canary (0.5%) complete. metrics: error_rate=0.12%, p50=68ms, p95=190ms. proceeding to 5% per schedule.

ben: seeing slight uptick in db times but within baseline. proceeding.

deploy-bot: 5% cohort rollout complete. metrics: error_rate=0.3%, p95=210ms (+20ms). next step paused for holdpoint per plan. awaiting manual approve or rollback.

carla: I want one more minute to inspect traces for tail latencies.

alice: taking a quick look — traces show a small number of requests hitting cold kv misses from a client path. not systemic. recommending continue to 25% but with faster rollback threshold: if error_rate > 0.6% revert flag.

dinesh: supportable. I'll be standing by. ops-oncall, ready to hit the toggle if needed?

ops-oncall: ready. curl to fast-disable: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"experiments/service-slimline","state":"off"}'` — will run if alerts fire or on command.

deploy-bot: executing step -> moving to 25% in 30s.

(30s later)

ops-oncall: :warning: alert firing: error_rate=0.74% in last 2m, p95_delta=280ms. escalating.

ben: confirmed in grafana panel, spike correlates with a background job hitting the new path.

alice: rolling back to previous flag state. ops-oncall, run the disable now.

ops-oncall: running disable command now. `200 OK` from flags API. flag state -> OFF.

deploy-bot: rollback action executed by ops-oncall. r-20260320-ff1 marked ROLLED_BACK. notes: rollback reason = error_rate+p95 spike after 5% -> 25% transition.

carla: after-action: we should add KV warmup to the preflight checklist and simulate background job load in canary.

alice: agree. will update release notes and add checklist item. re-schedule a small paced canary tomorrow with adjusted prewarm and a stricter holdpoint. thanks everyone for quick responses :thumbsup:

ben: filing a follow-up task: ENG-6123 to run canary with background-job replay.

dinesh: leaving the on-call routing as-is. will re-open when ready to retry.

deploy-bot: incident note created: INC-20260320-ff1. linked to r-20260320-ff1 and ENG-6123.
